about: Delivery profiles for finish.js master. Each is an ffmpeg video/audio encode. The master keeps the full quality; the youtube copies are what is uploaded; preview is for the phone. A profile that needs an encoder the local ffmpeg lacks falls back to the profile named in 'fallback'. Sizes: 'source' keeps the render's size (render at the size you deliver; never upscale a render), or WxH to downscale.

mezzanine.what: the archival master: ProRes 422 HQ, 10-bit, PCM audio

mezzanine_ffv1.what: lossless master when ProRes is missing: FFV1 10-bit

youtube.what: the upload: HEVC Main10 at the render's size, 10-bit so twilight skies do not band

youtube_h264.what: the upload when HEVC is missing: H.264 High, high bitrate, 8-bit (dithered)

preview.what: for the phone and the Drive: 720p, fast
